integrity: The theorem is proved from the induced-path and complement structure of complete multipartite graphs and independently checked from graph definitions on bounded instances.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
Finite exhaustive verification covers orders two through nine and is corroborative only.
A 2026 same-topic paper was accessible only at abstract level; differently phrased overlap remains a residual literature risk.
title: Monophonic global domination in complete multipartite graphs
